description: Names, chat, reactions, friends, public, friends-only or private parties and an in-app notifications inbox (invites, new titles, admin announcements, requests) for SyncPlay watch parties in WonderFlix, recommendations between friends, what friends are watching, a movie match (friends swipe yes or no on titles and start a party with the ones everyone likes), friends' ratings (a 1 to 10 rating with a comment at the end of a watch party, revealed to everyone at once, and friends' ratings on the title page), problem reports (users report a problem on a title, admins are notified and close it) and subtitle search and download for admins and users allowed to manage subtitles, plus Seerr requests (search, request and approve movies and series), collections (sagas) and user pictures, and password recovery by Discord or e-mail, plus the WonderFlix Home rows chosen by the admin and the upcoming episodes and movies from Sonarr and Radarr, with a monthly release calendar and the release dates of requested titles.
name: WonderFlix Watch Party
overview: WonderFlix watch party: names, chat, reactions, friends, party modes, notifications, recommendations, friends activity, movie match, friends' ratings, problem reports, subtitle search, Seerr requests, collections, user pictures, password recovery, Home rows, upcoming from Sonarr and Radarr, release calendar
